primary_source.locator: printed p599 convergence and total cone-pedicle density; p596 and p604 shape/coverage limitations

size_method: Supplied v2 HC soma density and H1/H2 .8/.2; r<=.58mm central 8.04/12.22um; .58.. .60mm fixed C1 Hermite join; .6..1.338mm unmodified R=sqrt(D/(pi*rho_k)), D1=3.7+3.8*(r-.6)/4.9, D2=2.2.

central_policy.right_value: unmodified v2 outer contact radius at r=0.60mm
central_policy.right_derivative: analytic derivative of unmodified v2 outer contact formula
central_policy.width_status: fixed 20um engineering transition, not measured or tuned to spikes/contact counts
central_policy.scope: Only direct cone-contact radius; density coefficients and r>=0.6mm v2 formula unchanged
central_policy.shape_note: C1 join does not impose monotonicity; H1 may have a small local minimum because the right endpoint slope is positive

selection: all actual eligible cone pedicles inside the disk centered on each HC OPL anchor; H1 excludes S, H2 accepts L/M/S
counts: observed graph convergence/divergence; no imposed quota, radius enlargement or nearest fallback
normalization: A and B normalized once on the complete finite canonical graph; empty rows remain zero
support_interpretation: literature-constrained equal-area contact support; individual branches and measured maximum dendritic reach remain unresolved

qualitative_source.citation: Wassle, Boycott and Rohrenbeck (1989), Cone connections and dendritic network
qualitative_source.verification: abstract; H1/H2 fields increase with eccentricity; no numerical curve digitized
